extracted.name: Coconut & jam cake
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by Good Food member meganrosepw and has not been tested by our team.
instruction_lines: Add all of the cake ingredients to a mixing bowl.
Cool on a tray for 10-15 mins.
Spread all of the jam on top of the sponge and sprinkle the coconut on afterwards.
